rows.note: net-aware `clearance` always; the net-agnostic fab-view pass (`physical_copper_gap`, #8843) adds same-net copper but runs only when the effective --mfr is exactly `jlcpcb` -- a `jlcpcb-tier*` profile gets `clearance` alone. Observed 2 danger (0.08 mm).

as `trace_spacing`, plus the 2 oz pad mask-bridge check inside `physical_copper_gap`; that check judges a declared 2 oz outer weight only and otherwise reports `physical_copper_gap_incomplete` at info. Observed 8 danger.

`mask_to_copper` is default-on for an explicit --mfr `jlcpcb*` since #8842 (interim 0.09 mm danger / 0.15 mm warning); a bare `kct check` with no --mfr does not engage it, and the native path needs an unmodified saved source. Observed 5 danger.

`tht_smd_spacing` (#8843) judges plated through-hole *component* pads only: vias are excluded by default and same-footprint pad pairs are skipped, while JLCDFM flags through-hole pads and vias. Fab-view gated -- runs only when the effective --mfr is exactly `jlcpcb`. Observed 5 danger.
